T: I'm bad. And that's good. Pass the pie.
D: An arcade game villain tired of being the bad guy goes game-jumping to win a medal.
P: Serve dessert when the Nicelanders hand Felix a pie at the anniversary party.
S: the candy racing game Sugar Rush
Gummy lollies, jelly beans, marshmallows and chocolate buttons tipped into a big bowl with crushed honeycomb.
the candy go-karts in Sugar Rush
Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate and rolled in sprinkles, set on baking paper.
the alien shooter game Hero's Duty
Corn chips layered with beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, with salsa and guacamole.
M: Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
Ralph smashing the bricks of the apartment building
Eight huge beef and parmesan meatballs browned and simmered in tomato sauce, then served over a pile of spaghetti.
W: the pies the Nicelanders give Felix
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, a gold star piped on top.
K: the fizzing mountain in Sugar Rush
Cola poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a tall glass so it froths over the top.

s.note: the candy racing game Sugar Rush
s.how: Tip 200g gummy lollies, 200g jelly beans, 100g marshmallows and 100g chocolate buttons into a big bowl. Break 100g honeycomb into chunks and scatter over the top. Set it out like a racetrack made of sweets.

s.note: the candy go-karts in Sugar Rush
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way in, letting the extra drip off. Roll in sprinkles straight away and lay on baking paper to set. Stand them in a glass like a bunch of candy karts ready to race.

m.note: Ralph smashing the bricks of the apartment building
m.how: Mix 600g beef mince with 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 50g grated parmesan and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Roll into 8 big wrecking ball meatballs, brown all over, then simmer in 700g passata for 25 minutes. Serve over 400g cooked spaghetti.

w.note: the pies the Nicelanders give Felix
w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Pipe a gold star on top and serve with ice cream.

d.note: the fizzing mountain in Sugar Rush
d.how: Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream into each tall glass. Slowly pour cold cola over the top so it fizzes up and froths over the rim like a volcano. Stand the glasses on plates and serve with long spoons.
